sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - Model 870 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Just when I finally sorted out the stable Internet connection and power supply for it, the Government stepped up the game and started blocking half the IP addresses that handled most of the data flow in Tarkov. All that because TerraGroup allegedly uses "Ebambium" ISP to further destabilize the situation in the city and wreak havoc. Sounds like some gibberish about the Ragnarok coming, don't you think? By the way about gibberish and weapons — some weirdo with a lightning symbol tattooed on his face asked for a Remington 870 shotgun. Equipped with a tactical device, Magpul MOE handguard, and a tactical foregrip. Ergonomics above 60 and recoil sum less than 500."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 10 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a Remington Model 870 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +4,100 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.01
- 300 Dollars
  - 315 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 345 Dollars Intelligence Center Level 2
- 3× Weapon parts
"Great gun, a solid build."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
M870 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 500 or less recoil
- 60 or more ergonomics
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)
- Any foregrip
- M870 Magpul MOE handguard

sections.heading: Builds
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard M870 from Skier LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
